answers.explanation: A species is a group of closely related organisms that can interbreed to produce fertile offspring.
Euglena can feed holozoically on food particles in the dark, which keeps it alive when light is absent.
The cytoplasm suspends all the cell organelles and holds them in place.
Water moves into the thistle funnel by osmosis because the sugar solution is more concentrated, so the level rises.
The experiment demonstrates osmosis, the movement of water through a partially permeable membrane.
In a plant cell, the cytoplasm acts as the partially permeable membrane that controls the movement of water.
Haemolysis is the bursting of red blood cells that occurs when they are placed in distilled water.
The growth movement of plant roots towards water is called hydrotropism.
Glycolysis converts one glucose molecule into two pyruvate molecules, producing a net gain of 2 ATP.
The femur is the longest bone in the human body.
Muscle is a soft tissue and is not a skeletal material, while chitin, cartilage and bone are.
Blood flows slowly through the capillaries to allow enough time for exchange of materials with the tissues.
Fishes, amphibians, birds and man all excrete through kidneys.
Arteries do not have valves along their length, so this is not a characteristic of arteries.
The bird's body temperature varies much less than the lizard's when the environmental temperature changes.
Poikilothermy describes animals such as lizards whose body temperature changes with the environment.
Saline solutions maintain the composition of body fluids, whereas plain water would upset the balance of salts.
The cochlea contains the nerve cells that respond to sound vibrations.
Convex lenses converge light rays before they enter the eye, which corrects long-sightedness.
A seed is the developed ovule, containing the embryo and food store.
Photosynthesis removes carbon(IV) oxide from the atmosphere and fixes it into organic compounds.
Precipitation and transpiration are steps in the water cycle.
Below the photic zone there is too little light for photosynthesis, so light intensity is the limiting factor.
A quadrat is used to estimate the number of plants in a habitat by sampling a small area.
Sandy soil is light and easy to dig because its particles are large and loosely packed.
Sheep are herbivores that feed directly on plants, so they are primary consumers.
P is the producer at the start of the food chain, and it gets its energy from sunlight.
R is the third organism in the chain, which makes it a secondary consumer.
Scabies is caused by a mite that is spread by contact and is not inherited.
In flowering plants the immediate products of meiosis are pollen grains, which develop from microspores.
DNA in eukaryotic cells is contained in the nucleus.
A heterozygous man crossed with a double recessive woman gives 50 percent affected offspring.
Cytokinesis divides the cytoplasm and its organelles between the two daughter cells.
A diurnal animal is one that is active during the day.
Mutation is a mechanism of evolution, not evidence for it.
The eggs are laid outside the body of the frog, so the organisms are oviparous.
The posture in which the male clasps the female during breeding is called amplexus.
DNA analysis gives an accurate identification of an individual from biological material.
Schistosomiasis is contracted by swimming in fresh water and causes blood in the urine.
Whale flippers and fish fins have similar function but different ancestry, which is convergent evolution.
